title: Check whether a proxy predicts the outcome
when: A proxy score is used as evidence that a system succeeded or failed
found: A similarity measure can reward shared vocabulary even when the task failed
how: Join the proxy measurements to independent labels by example ID. Compare the score distributions for successes and failures. Check a concrete alternative signal on the same examples.
evidence: Public synthetic reconstruction: an irrelevant response repeats all expected words, while a useful response succeeds using a synonym. Compare against an independent completion check.
